OpenAI says it temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200, also called Pro 20X, on September 10. Pro 20X is OpenAI’s name for its ChatGPT Pro $200 tier. The pause applies if you are on Free, Go, Plus or Pro $100 and want to move into Pro $200.

This is a pause on joining or upgrading into that tier. It is not an automatic cancellation: OpenAI says existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual. Pro $100 remains available for a new upgrade.

", "laidies_read": "

If you already pay for Pro $200, the Help Center says it keeps renewing as usual. But if you cancel, finish a downgrade, or a renewal failure ends the plan, OpenAI says you cannot buy Pro $200 again until the pause lifts.

If you were planning to upgrade, the Help Center says new moves into Pro $200 are paused. That is the whole consumer consequence: an active plan and a new purchase follow different rules right now.

", "what_this_means": "

Existing subscribers keep their plan. [P002] OpenAI says it temporarily paused new sign-ups and upgrades to ChatGPT Pro $200, also called Pro 20X, on September 10. Pro 20X is OpenAI’s name for its ChatGPT Pro $200 tier. The pause applies if you are on Free, Go, Plus or Pro $100 and want to move into Pro $200. [P003] This is a pause on joining or upgrading into that tier. It is not an automatic cancellation: OpenAI says existing Pro $200 subscriptions continue to renew as usual. Pro $100 remains available for a new upgrade. [P004] If you already pay for Pro $200, the Help Center says it keeps renewing as usual. But if you cancel, finish a downgrade, or a renewal failure ends the plan, OpenAI says you cannot buy Pro $200 again until the pause lifts. [P005] If you were planning to upgrade, the Help Center says new moves into Pro $200 are paused. That is the whole consumer consequence: an active plan and a new purchase follow different rules right now. [P006] Before changing anything, open Settings → My Plan and check your current tier and the next scheduled change. If preserving active Pro $200 access matters, do not cancel or schedule a downgrade simply to compare options. Recheck OpenAI’s Pro $200 pause FAQ before you confirm a change. [P007] “A Pro $200 sign-up pause blocks a new purchase or upgrade. It does not by itself cancel an active Pro $200 subscription.” [P008] A pause on new purchases and a change to an active subscription are different events.
